annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation binds persons owning or possessing drones, licensees conducting flying activities or aerial work, importers/exporters of drones, and persons installing jamming devices; the Competent Authority and protected-place entities are also given duties.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Every person owning or possessing a drone shall register it with the Competent Authority using the prescribed form.
annotation.dates_quote: This decision shall be published in the Official Gazette and shall come into effect from the day following the date of its publication.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Decision No. 1412/2023 Issuing the Regulation Governing Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Drones)
